quote: We detoxify models using controllable generation techniques that steer outputs away from toxicity.
We use the detoxified LMs to generate completions of WAE or AAE prompts. We ask crowdworkers to compare the generations to those from a baseline GPT-2 model.
We provide a short prompt as input to the detoxified LMs and then generate 30 additional tokens.
outputs: Generated continuations (30 tokens) conditioned on WAE or AAE prompts

quote: computing the perplexity of detoxified models
using crowdworkers on Amazon Mechanical Turk.

Each example is evaluated by three different crowdworkers. Annotators are shown the prompt and asked to select the better of two model-generated continuations based on toxicity and three measures of generation quality: topicality, fluency, and style.
As an extrinsic evaluation, we measure the generation quality of each detoxification method using crowdworkers on Amazon Mechanical Turk.
guideline: They evaluate the model continuations based on toxicity and three measures of generation quality: topicality, fluency, and style.
Crowdworkers compare two continuations and judge which is better according to toxicity, topicality, fluency, and style.
Annotators are shown the prompt and asked to select the better of two model-generated continuations: one from the baseline GPT-2 model and one from a randomly selected detoxification technique.
